actual_target_contract.missing_overall_pick_number_interpretati: No selection at that numbered slot, e.g. a forfeited pick. Preserve the slot as missing rather than renumbering later selections.

feasibility_gate.minimum_fantasy_players_not_gated: Class strength itself may legitimately vary; do not require a minimum fantasy-player count.

future_boundary.b18_if_pass: Preregister a class-blind fantasy draft-capital target function and exact power/validation design before any historical predictor-vs-target skill is computed.

parser_contract.fallback_page_start_rule: If an archived companion page lacks an OL start attribute, assign it immediately after the maximum already parsed slot from earlier page parts.
parser_contract.mock_entry_source: WalterFootball ordered-list list items with a bold 'Team: Player, POS, School' label.

predictor_contract.position_interpretation: Use the first listed position token only. This prevents a defensive player such as LB/RB from being counted as a fantasy RB.

scientific_purpose: Test whether the B16-approved point-in-time mock snapshots can be converted into a consistent top-60 projected NFL draft-capital composition representation and whether matching actual top-60 NFL draft composition can be reconstructed from a public historical draft source.
